steps.en: Point one command at any image in the local registry
steps.zh: 一条命令指向本地任意镜像

steps.en: Starts the container and exercises it via HTTP probe and your --exec commands
steps.zh: 启动容器，用 HTTP 探针和你给的 --exec 命令施压

steps.en: Records every file access and syscall, then rebuilds a .slim image with only what was used
steps.zh: 记录实际用到的文件和系统调用，重建只含这些产物的 .slim 镜像

steps.en: Run the minified image and verify it still behaves
steps.zh: 跑一下瘦身后的镜像，验证行为不变

value.en: An image up to 30x smaller plus generated Seccomp/AppArmor profiles, without touching the Dockerfile
value.zh: 不改 Dockerfile，镜像最多小 30 倍，还附带生成好的 Seccomp/AppArmor 配置

sources: slimtoolkit/slim README.md (master, retrieved 2026-09-28): Homebrew section 'brew install docker-slim'

README.md usage section: 'slim build your-name/your-app'; overview example 'slim build --target archlinux:latest --tag archlinux:curl --http-probe=false --exec "curl checkip.amazonaws.com"' followed by 'docker run archlinux:curl curl checkip.amazonaws.com'
README.md seccomp section: 'docker run --security-opt seccomp:<...>.json'; --include-path allowlist example; Overview lists the 'xray' inspection command
